THREATS.name: Central European Convective Weather
THREATS.summary: Severe CB activity forecast across the FRA–MUC–VIE corridor through the afternoon wave. Embedded thunderstorms, hail, and wind shear on approach corridors. Ground stops likely at VIE during peak arrival bank.

THREATS.name: Frankfurt ATFM Regulation — Sector Overload
THREATS.summary: EUROCONTROL Network Manager has activated an ATFM regulation for the Frankfurt airspace sector due to predicted overload. Delays of 30–60 minutes expected on all EuroVista sectors transiting the EDUU UIR.

THREATS.name: Vienna Winter Storm — Snow Accumulation
THREATS.summary: Heavy snowfall forecast at VIE from late evening through overnight. Runway clearance cycles expected to reduce arrival rate by 40%. De-icing operations will extend turnaround times by 25–35 minutes.

THREATS.name: Zurich Low-Visibility Procedures
THREATS.summary: Radiation fog at ZRH reducing visibility below 300m. CAT II/III approaches in effect. EuroVista E190 fleet limited to CAT I minima — diversions to MUC possible for 2 rotations.

THREATS.name: Vienna Ground Handler Industrial Action
THREATS.summary: VIE ground handling staff have announced a 4-hour work-to-rule during the morning departure bank. Extended turnaround times and potential missed connections through the VIE hub.

THREATS.name: Amsterdam Slot Constraints — Runway Maintenance
THREATS.summary: AMS runway 18R/36L closed for scheduled maintenance through the week. Reduced arrival capacity during peak hours; slot adjustments required for EuroVista's 4 daily AMS rotations.

VULNERABILITIES.title: VIE hub concentration
VULNERABILITIES.detail: All connecting traffic flows through a single hub — no secondary European gateway. Any VIE disruption has system-wide impact.

VULNERABILITIES.title: E195 CAT I limitation
VULNERABILITIES.detail: The E190/E195 fleet is limited to CAT I approach minima, creating diversion risk at fog-affected airports like ZRH and GVA.

VULNERABILITIES.title: FRA corridor dependency
VULNERABILITIES.detail: Over 40% of European trunk routes transit the Frankfurt airspace sector — ATFM regulations here have outsized impact.

VULNERABILITIES.title: Single ground handler at VIE
VULNERABILITIES.detail: One handler serves all EuroVista turns at VIE — industrial action has no immediate alternate.
